How it works

Every mission runs the same 12 stages.

A predictable route from brief to evidence, with human feedback along the way.

  1. 01

    BRIEF

    Understand the scenario, audience and definition of done.

  2. 02

    LEARN

    Study the concepts, patterns and safety points the task needs.

  3. 03

    INVESTIGATE

    Gather requirements, inspect evidence and test assumptions.

  4. 04

    TRY

    Run a small guided experiment before committing.

  5. 05

    BUILD

    Create the requested artefact against the constraints.

  6. 06

    BREAK

    Probe failure cases, edge cases and resilience.

  7. 07

    FIX

    Correct defects and document meaningful changes.

  8. 08

    TEST

    Run checks and capture repeatable results.

  9. 09

    EXPLAIN

    Explain choices, trade-offs and limitations.

  10. 10

    DEFEND

    Answer questions and evidence-based challenge.

  11. 11

    SHIP

    Package the result for a defined handoff.

  12. 12

    EVIDENCE

    Submit the evidence pack and notes for assessment.

FAQ

Questions we get asked.

How much does it cost?

Courses start at $3 and bundles run from $3 to $50. Every purchase is one-time, with lifetime access and no subscription.

What is included in a purchase?

Every lesson, checkpoint and practice lab in the course or bundle, plus the assessed evidence route. You only see what you have bought.

Can I upgrade from a course to a bundle?

Yes. Buying a bundle that contains a course you already own credits the value of that course, so you pay only the difference.

Who reviews my work?

A qualified human reviewer marks your lab evidence against a published rubric. AI may coach, but it never issues a credential.

Is a certificate a job guarantee?

No. Learning, assessment and independent verification are separate records. Participation does not by itself provide employment, a visa, a licence or accreditation.

Can my employer see my progress?

Not by default. Evidence is private until you choose to share it, and only for the purpose you approve.

What is the refund policy?

Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase, provided no assessment has been submitted.

Where do I sign in and study?

Everything happens in the Academy app. Use any “Open Academy” button on this page to continue.
